QuestInfo.name: Wounded Hands
QuestInfo.0: You've put out the worst of the flames. Speak with Sugar in front of the Maple Tree.
QuestInfo.1: Sugar burned herself in the fire. She requests more water from the #bSplit Road of Destiny#k\r\n\r\n#rIf you fail to complete the quest, forfeit the quest then speak with Sugar to start the quest again.#k
QuestInfo.2: You brought the water, but instead of using it to treat her wounds, Sugar pours it on the tree. She says she'll be fine.
QuestInfo.rewardSummary:
#Wbasic#

Can proceed to Maple Island in Ruins

0.0: We were almost too late, but you saved the day.  \r\n#L0##bHey, your hands are scarlet! You didn't try to pat the fire out with your bare hands, did you?!#l\n#k
0.1: Oh, um, I might've. \r\n#L0##bWe need to treat your wounds!#l\n#k
0.2: Oh, it's nothing. But, if you really don't mind... Could you get me some more cold water?

yes.0: Here's your bucket back. Bring me some more water, just like earlier.

no.0: I told you it's no big deal. Don't give it another thought.

1.0: Sorry you had to make a second trip. \r\n(Sugar pours the water onto the last sizzling section of the tree instead of her wounds.)

npc.0: You don't need to talk to Lucas this time. Just head to the #bSplit Road of Destiny#k and fill it with water again. I mean, if you don't mind.
